HOME.TITLE: Presidents and soccer in Colombia
HOME.LEAD: A visual journey that connects the governments of Colombia with key episodes of national football. Explore each stage and discover how sports have reflected our history, based on the Secret Histories episode: the presidents and football by Alejandro Pino Calad and Wallas.

TIMELINE.TITLE: Presidents and soccer in Colombia
TIMELINE.INTRO: Travel through history with context, images, and links for each period.

ABOUT.TITLE: About this project
ABOUT.P1: It all started after watching an episode of
ABOUT.P1_END: That episode opened my eyes to the deep connections between Colombian politics and national football. It impacted me so much that I decided to create this timeline as a personal exercise to visualize all the information mentioned there, organizing it chronologically and complementing it with additional data and references of my own.
ABOUT.P2: This project is made with deep respect for the original journalistic work and with the aim of promoting sports journalism with a critical approach. I firmly believe that football in Colombia cannot be understood without looking at its political and social context, and this tool seeks to facilitate that reading for anyone interested in our history.
ABOUT.ACK_HISTORIAS: Special thanks to the team behind
ABOUT.ACK_HISTORIAS_END: Their investigative work was the seed of this project. Without their journalistic rigor and passion for telling these stories, this timeline would not exist.
